title: 第1031章 唯一真境第1030章 度化天劫一连两境
slug: 逆天悟性我在修仙界证道长生
content_zh:
九幽魔祖，亿万冥土的唯一主宰，屹立于魔道绝巅的无上存在！
毫不夸张地讲，他就是整座冥界的精神图腾。纵是威震诸天的八大祖神，在他面前也要躬身俯首，不敢存半分僭越之念。
长久以来，诸天万界流传着一种共识：魔祖早已踏入不假外物的至高境界，即便是三生镜这等混沌神器，于他而言也不过锦上添花，故而只能屈居榜单第三位。
“这小子到底在渡什么劫？竟连三生神光都惹出来了！”
绝空心头沉如铅汞，失魂落魄地立于暴雨之中，周身气息凝滞，宛如一尊被抽去灵魂的石雕。
魔祖的威严早已深入人心，哪怕他再狂妄自大，也绝不敢抗衡三生神光，这和自寻死路毫无区别！
如此一来，他只能祈祷天劫发威，将这个绝世妖孽轰杀成渣，为冥族永绝后患。
可接下来的一幕，却用最残酷的方式告诉他，什么叫痴心妄想！
五气朝元，大道归真！
沈云心念如电，将造化大道运转到极致。
刹那间，五气宇宙应声显化，遮天蔽日，横亘于万古苍穹之上！
轰隆隆——！！
五座大世界在虚空中交织演化，融为一体。以轮回法则为基，以时空秩序为骨，最终由造化落下画龙点睛的一笔。
紫气东来三万里，玄黄气贯九重天！
这一刻，整片天地共振交感，异象纷呈。
麒麟踏云、仙凤振翅、白泽长鸣.....万千瑞彩纷至沓来，竟将死气盘踞的碎空魔冢，逆转成一方仙灵净土。
而在漫天庆云的簇拥之中，鸿蒙宇宙终于彻底显化，如梦似幻、包罗万象，尽显造物主的无上权能！
唰！！
恰在此时，三生神光自九霄骤然劈落。
斩岁月史诗，断因果轮回，在那所向披靡的锋芒面前，大罗仙尊也要神形俱灭、万劫不复！

然而，当它触及鸿蒙宇宙的刹那，无匹神力却极速衰竭，如同一颗划破夜空的枯寂陨星。
时间固然伟大，能让天荒地老、沧海变桑田，可面对一座生机磅礴的浩瀚宇宙，却难以将其送入寂灭的彼岸。
至少，这道天劫演化出的三生神光，还远没有这等极致伟力！
在鸿蒙宇宙的同化之下，神光的光芒愈发黯淡，就连天道不断汇聚而来的本源力量，也被造化大道彻底隔绝，得不到半点补充！
嘭——
终于在某一刻，那道横贯古今的神光彻底湮灭，绚丽而又短暂，印证了那句流传万古的谶语：
蝴蝶再美，终究飞不过沧海。
哗！
漫天劫云如潮水般褪去，一股超脱诸天的大逍遥、大自在，于沈云心间缓缓流淌。
他如同洗尽铅华，每一根发丝都在发光，独立于浩瀚尘世之中，却又超脱于古史之外。
哪怕是绝空这等盖世高手，也瞬间显得自惭形秽、气质萎靡，双方的气场与神采，恰似天上流云与沼泽烂泥，根本不可同日而语。
“竟然.....真的只有三个呼吸。”
暗自酝酿退路的万烬生，此刻已彻底被吓傻了，哪还有往日运筹帷幄的气度？
content_en:
The Nine Nether Demon Ancestor, the sole master of billions of underworlds, the supreme being who stands at the pinnacle of the demonic path!
It is no exaggeration to say that he is the spiritual totem of the entire underworld. Even the eight great ancestral gods, who are so powerful in the heavens, must bow before him and dare not think of any arrogance.
For a long time, there has been a consensus in the world: Demon Ancestor has already entered the supreme realm of not fake foreign objects. Even chaos artifacts such as the Three Life Mirror are just icing on the cake for him, so he can only be ranked third on the list.
"What kind of calamity is this kid trying to survive? He even provoked the divine light of the Three Lives!"
Juekong's heart was as heavy as lead and mercury, and he stood in the heavy rain in a state of despair, with the aura around him stagnant, like a stone sculpture with its soul removed.
The majesty of the Demon Ancestor has long been deeply rooted in the hearts of the people. No matter how arrogant he is, he will never dare to compete with the divine light of Sansheng. This is no different from seeking death!
In this way, he could only pray for the Heavenly Tribulation to show its power and kill this peerless evildoer to nothing, so as to avoid future troubles for the Nether Clan forever.
But the next scene told him in the cruelest way what wishful thinking was!
The five qi are in full swing, and the true path is restored!
Chen Yun's thoughts were like lightning, operating the Great Way of Creation to the extreme.
In an instant, the five-qi universe appeared in response, covering the sky and the sun, and stretching across the eternal sky!
Rumble——! !
The five great worlds intertwine and evolve in the void, integrating into one. It is based on the law of reincarnation, based on the order of time and space, and finally the finishing touch is made by creation.
The purple energy comes thirty thousand miles from the east, and the black and yellow energy penetrates the ninth heaven!
At this moment, the whole world resonated with each other, and there were various visions.
The unicorn steps on the clouds, the fairy phoenix flutters its wings, the white zebra sings... Thousands of auspicious colors come one after another, turning the Shattered Sky Demon Tomb entrenched in death energy into a pure land of fairy spirits.
And surrounded by the sky full of Qingyun, the Hongmeng Universe finally manifested itself, dreamlike and all-encompassing, fully demonstrating the supreme power of the Creator!
Uh-huh! !
At this moment, the divine light of the Three Lives suddenly fell from the sky.
Cutting off the epic of time and breaking the reincarnation of cause and effect, in the face of that invincible edge, Daluo Immortal Lord will also be destroyed in spirit and form, and will never be restored!
However, the moment it touched the Hongmeng Universe, the unrivaled divine power rapidly depleted, like a dead meteor that cut through the night sky.
Although time is great, it can make the world grow old and change the vast sea into mulberry fields, but in the face of a vast universe full of vitality, it is difficult to send it to the other side of death.
At least, the three-life divine light evolved from this heavenly tribulation is far from such ultimate power!
Under the assimilation of Hongmeng Universe, the light of divine light becomes increasingly dim, and even the source power that is constantly gathered by the way of heaven is completely isolated by the avenue of creation, without any replenishment!
Bang——
Finally, at a certain moment, the divine light that spanned ancient and modern times was completely annihilated. It was brilliant but short-lived, confirming the prophecy that has been passed down through the ages:
No matter how beautiful the butterfly is, it cannot fly across the sea.
Wow!
The calamity clouds all over the sky faded away like the tide, and a great freedom and freedom that transcended the heavens slowly flowed in Chen Yun's heart.
It was as if all the lead had been washed away, and every strand of his hair was shining. He was independent of the vast world, but also transcended ancient history.
Even an unparalleled master like Jue Kong suddenly looked ashamed and depressed. The aura and energy of both parties were just like the clouds in the sky and the mud in the swamp. They were completely different.
"It turns out...there are really only three breaths."
Wan Jinsheng, who was secretly planning a retreat, was completely frightened. How could he still have the courage to strategize in the past?
